messages:
Sam: Quick UX check 3 compact list view at 380px: icon-only row actions have focus rings clipped and the row padding feels cramped. Screenshot attached.
Priya: I saw that. The toolbar uses overflow:hidden which clips outlines. We should render focus ring via an inner pseudo element or relax overflow when a child is focused.
Jorge: For consistency let's use a responsive hit token instead of magic pixels. Proposal: add `space-dense` as an alias to spacing-06 and map it responsively so compact components can scale.
Sam: Agree on token. Also ensure icon buttons get at least 36px touch area on dense layouts and 44px on mobile. Can `space-dense` drive that?
Priya: Yes, token can resolve to 36px at desktop dense and 44px under the touch breakpoint. CSS will compute padding from token minus icon size.
Jorge: I'll PR two changes: 1) token alias `space-dense` with responsive values, 2) CSS change to render focus ring on pseudo element so it doesn't escape the clipping context.
DesignBot: Note: adding `space-dense` as an alias to spacing-06. Please include deprecation guidance if you later rename tokens.
Sam: Also small copy nudge: change tooltip "More" to "Row actions" and add visually-hidden text with row identity for SRs.
Priya: Good call. I'll run a11y pass after the PR and test VoiceOver and NVDA.
Jorge: PR opened (#5234). I'll include visual diffs at 320/380/768 and a short GIF. ETA tomorrow morning.
Sam: Thanks team, please paste staging link when it's up. :thumbsup:
